product_overview: Herbaformix is a healthy living and nutrition tracking platform for distributors/coaches and their customers. It combines customer onboarding, daily habit tracking, client management, product cataloging, and personalized nutrition/exercise program creation in one Flutter app.
core_goals: Sign in to the app and access the appropriate authenticated workspace
Complete initial customer onboarding with personal and health information
Track daily water intake toward a goal
Log and review daily calorie intake
Manage customers, their progress, and profile details
Browse, add, and edit products in the catalog
Create and save personalized nutrition and exercise programs for customers
View progress history and photos to monitor changes over time

features.name: Kullanıcı Girişi
features.description: Users can sign in with email and password and be routed into the authenticated experience.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit login form -> See the home dashboard

features.name: Su Takipçisi
features.description: Authenticated users can record daily water intake and monitor progress toward their daily hydration goal.
user_flows: Navigate to /home/water-tracker -> Add a glass of water -> Observe the daily progress bar update
Navigate to /home/water-tracker -> Remove a glass of water -> Observe the daily progress bar decrease

features.name: Kalori Takipçisi
features.description: Authenticated users can log foods with calorie values and review their daily calorie total.
user_flows: Navigate to /home/calorie-tracker -> Add a consumed food with its name and calorie value -> Review the daily total calorie graph
Navigate to /home/calorie-tracker -> Delete a consumed food record -> Review the updated daily total calorie graph

features.name: Danışan Yönetimi
features.description: Coaches can view active customers, add a new customer, and inspect customer profiles and progress data.
user_flows: Navigate to /home/customers -> View the active customer list -> Open a customer profile -> Review progress graphs
Navigate to /home/customers -> Start adding a new customer -> Fill in customer details -> Save the customer record -> See the customer appear in the list

features.name: Ürün Kataloğu
features.description: Authenticated users can browse the product catalog, search for products, and add or edit products with appropriate permissions.
user_flows: Navigate to /home/products -> View product categories and product lists -> Search for a specific product by name -> Open the product details
Navigate to /home/products -> Start adding a new product -> Fill in product information -> Save the product -> See the product in the catalog
Navigate to /home/products -> Open an existing product for editing -> Update product information -> Save the changes -> Return to the product detail view

features.name: Beslenme ve Egzersiz Programlayıcı
features.description: Coaches can build a customer-specific daily nutrition and exercise program and save it for assignment.
user_flows: Navigate to /home/create-program -> Select the target and program goal -> Enter starting weight and target weight -> Continue to meal planning

Navigate to /home/create-program -> Choose days and meal slots -> Mark each meal as a normal meal or a product-based meal -> Add Herbalife or custom food items to the selected meals -> Continue to review
Navigate to /home/create-program -> Review the program summary -> Save the program -> See the program stored for the customer
